avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may reduce naratriptan levels; serotonergic activity increases serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue St. John's Wort at least 2 weeks before naratriptan use; consider alternative mood support if needed

avoid_supplements.name: SAMe (S-Adenosyl methionine)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Serotonergic supplement increases risk of serotonin syndrome when combined with triptan
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; discuss alternative supplements with healthcare provider

avoid_supplements.name: 5-HTP
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Direct serotonin precursor; significant additive serotonergic effect increases serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Do not combine; allow at least 2 weeks washout between treatments

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild serotonergic activity; theoretical additive effect with naratriptan
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive serotonergic symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia); use lowest effective dose

caution_supplements.name: Feverfew
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have independent migraine-preventive effects; additive vasoconstrictive potential
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure and cardiovascular symptoms; may be beneficial as preventive agent separate from acute dosing

avoid_foods.name: Foods high in tyramine (aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented foods)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Triptans have mild MAOI-like properties; tyramine can cause hypertensive crisis via monoamine interaction
avoid_foods.action: Limit tyramine-rich foods; counsel on moderation rather than strict avoidance

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-containing beverages and foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Caffeine may enhance migraine relief but increases cardiovascular stimulation and jitteriness
caution_foods.action: Moderate caffeine intake around naratriptan dosing; patient preference and tolerance should guide use

monitoring_notes: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, rapid heart rate, muscle rigidity, hyperthermia) particularly if combining with other serotonergic agents. Assess blood pressure and cardiovascular status given naratriptan's vasoconstrictive properties, especially in patients with cardiac risk factors.
